prompt: The black leather wallet on the reception desk ___ to a visitor from Leeds.
explanation_ru: Глагол belong (принадлежать) не употребляется в пассиве; для единственного числа (wallet) нужен актив: belongs.

prompt: Jill uses a helpful language app on her mobile phone. Whenever she finishes a short lesson, new points (to add) to her score. Her younger brother (to use) the same program to learn Spanish.
explanation_ru: Баллы добавляются к результату (пассив: are added), а её младший брат сам пользуется этой программой (актив: uses).

prompt: Pete walked out of the office smiling because the manager (to offer) him the sales role.
explanation_ru: Менеджер сам предложил ему должность (действие выполняет подлежащее the manager), поэтому нужен активный залог: offered.

prompt: Cheer up, Cole—you (to pick) for the starting team in the weekend basketball game!
explanation_ru: Тебя выбрали в стартовый состав, и эта новость актуальна сейчас — нужен Present Perfect Passive: have been picked.

prompt: Before our dinner guests arrived, all the fresh bread rolls ___ and placed in a warm basket.
explanation_ru: Булочки испекли ещё до прихода гостей в прошлом (arrived), поэтому требуется Past Perfect Passive: had been baked.

prompt: Take the express train from platform two, and you (to reach) the coast in forty minutes.
explanation_ru: Вы сами доберётесь до побережья; после повелительного наклонения (Take) используется Future Simple Active: will reach.

prompt: Rose is thrilled because all her heavy furniture (can / to move) into the new flat in one trip.
explanation_ru: Мебель не перевозит сама себя — её можно перевезти, поэтому после модального глагола can ставится be + V3: can be moved.

prompt: We often chat with the friendly couple next door while we (to water) our front flowers.
explanation_ru: Мы сами поливаем цветы в процессе разговора (while), поэтому нужен Present Continuous Active: are watering.

prompt: I tried to upload my final project files from my home computer this morning. Unfortunately, our whole street (to lose) its internet connection during a storm. Before the connection returned, the submission link (to close) automatically by the system. I had to call my tutor to explain the delay.
explanation_ru: Улица потеряла связь с интернетом (актив: lost), а ссылка была закрыта системой ещё до того, как связь восстановилась в прошлом (Before... returned → had been closed).

prompt: Late visitors (not / to allow) into the theatre hall once the evening show begins.
explanation_ru: Опоздавших зрителей не пускают в зал по правилам театра — нужен Present Simple Passive: are not allowed.

prompt: Passengers on the morning flight (to show) their boarding passes at the gate before boarding.
explanation_ru: Пассажиры сами предъявляют посадочные талоны у выхода на посадку — регулярное действие в активном залоге: show.

prompt: Our class visited the science museum, where we (to guide) through the space exhibition.
explanation_ru: Нас провели по выставке в рамках рассказа о прошедшей экскурсии (visited), поэтому нужен Past Simple Passive: were guided.

prompt: Every international package (must / to weigh) carefully at the counter before the clerk prints a label.
explanation_ru: Посылку должны взвесить на стойке (действие направлено на package), поэтому после must ставится be + V3: must be weighed.

prompt: Situation: Jade booked a cozy wooden cabin near the lake for her summer holiday. Which sentence matches the situation?
options: A cozy wooden cabin near the lake booked Jade for her summer holiday.
A cozy wooden cabin near the lake was booked for Jade's summer holiday.
A cozy wooden cabin near the lake was book for Jade's summer holiday.
Jade was booked a cozy wooden cabin near the lake for her summer holiday.
explanation_ru: Домик у озера был забронирован для отпуска Джейд (Past Simple Passive: was booked); остальные варианты нарушают залог или грамматику.

prompt: Nate orders most of his winter clothes from a popular website. Whenever he places an order, a confirmation message (to email) to him right away. Last week, he (to return) a blue sweater because the sleeves were too short.
explanation_ru: Письмо с подтверждением отправляется автоматически (пассив: is emailed), а на прошлой неделе Нейт сам вернул свитер (актив: returned).

prompt: Our study group meets in the campus library every Thursday afternoon. Together, we (to review) the main lecture notes and share ideas. Any extra reading sheets (to print) by Vera before our session starts.
explanation_ru: Мы сами повторяем конспекты (актив: review), а дополнительные материалы распечатываются Верой (пассив: are printed).

prompt: These liquid eye drops (should / to store) in a cool, dark place after the bottle is opened.
explanation_ru: Капли следует хранить в прохладном месте (действие направлено на eye drops), поэтому после should нужна пассивная форма: should be stored.

prompt: Hey Nell, how long have you (to wait) outside the station in this chilly wind?
explanation_ru: Вопрос how long о действии, которое началось в прошлом и всё ещё длится, требует Present Perfect Continuous Active: been waiting.

prompt: Faye planned a surprise dinner for her sister's birthday. Colorful balloons (to tie) to the chairs in the dining room. When her sister walked in, everyone (to shout) a loud greeting.
explanation_ru: Шарики привязали к стульям (пассив: were tied), а гости сами громко поздравили именинницу (актив: shouted).

prompt: All hot dishes at this family restaurant (to prepare) with fresh vegetables from nearby farms.
explanation_ru: Горячие блюда готовят из свежих овощей (действие направлено на dishes), поэтому используется Present Simple Passive: are prepared.

prompt: We are thrilled because two extra rows of seats ___ near the main concert stage.
explanation_ru: Дополнительные ряды уже добавили (результат важен сейчас, множественное число rows), поэтому нужен Present Perfect Passive: have been added.

prompt: Drivers told the police that the traffic lights ___ nearly an hour before the two cars collided.
explanation_ru: Светофоры перестали работать сами (непереходное значение fail) ещё до столкновения в прошлом (collided), поэтому нужен Past Perfect Active: had failed.

prompt: Unfortunately, winter coat prices ___ across most high-street shops because wool costs more this season.
explanation_ru: Глагол rise (расти) непереходный и никогда не используется в пассиве; для множественного числа prices нужен актив: have risen.

prompt: Gwen could not use the running track because the wooden floor (to polish) all afternoon.
explanation_ru: Деревянный пол натирали весь день в прошлом (could not use), поэтому используется Past Continuous Passive: was being polished.

prompt: Look at the living room rug—you (to spill) dark tea right across the middle!
explanation_ru: Вы сами пролили чай, и результат виден прямо сейчас (Look at the rug) — нужен Present Perfect Active: have spilled.

prompt: Every morning, the office manager (to check) the meeting schedule before the staff arrive.
explanation_ru: Офис-менеджер сам проверяет расписание каждое утро (подлежащее выполняет действие), поэтому нужен актив: checks.

prompt: Readers are delighted because a bright new reading room has been built on the second floor.
answer: Readers are delighted because a bright new reading room has been built on the second floor.
accepted_answers: Readers are delighted because a bright new reading room has been built on the second floor.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: форма Present Perfect Passive с третьей формой глагола build (has been built) употреблена правильно.

prompt: We read in the local paper that our town bridge (to close) for safety checks next week.
explanation_ru: Слова next week указывают на запланированное закрытие моста в будущем — нужен Future Simple Passive: will be closed.

prompt: Students enjoy the new science club after classes. During each session, simple experiments (to perform) in small pairs. Everyone (to learn) useful skills while having a great time.
explanation_ru: Простые опыты проводятся парами (пассив: are performed), а каждый ученик сам осваивает полезные навыки (актив: learns).

prompt: Sorry to disappoint you, but the corner coffee shop ___ to have closed permanently last month.
explanation_ru: В пассивной конструкции с глаголом сообщения (говорится, что...) используется форма is said to have done: is said.

prompt: Heavy rain had been falling across the valley for three days. By Tuesday afternoon, several low fields (to flood) by the rising river. Local farmers (to move) their sheep to higher ground before the water reached the barns. Fortunately, the skies cleared by evening.
explanation_ru: Поля оказались затоплены рекой к указанному моменту в прошлом (пассив: had been flooded), а фермеры сами перегнали овец до того, как вода дошла до сараев (актив: had moved).

prompt: Before we leave the food store, all our groceries (to pack) into strong paper bags.
explanation_ru: Продукты упаковывают в бумажные пакеты (регулярное действие в настоящем), поэтому нужен Present Simple Passive: are packed.

prompt: All loan applications must be sign by two managers before the money can be released.
answer: All loan applications must be signed by two managers before the money can be released.
accepted_answers: All loan applications must be signed by two managers before the money can be released.
explanation_ru: В пассивной форме после модального глагола must be требуется третья форма глагола (V3): signed, а не sign.

prompt: I left my blue scarf on the bench for a minute, and it ___ completely.
explanation_ru: Глагол disappear непереходный (шарф исчез сам) и никогда не ставится в пассивный залог: disappeared.

prompt: Situation: The building notice warns us that the lift will stay out of order until Friday so workers can replace the cables. Which sentence matches the situation?
options: We must take the stairs because the lift cables are being replaced until Friday.
We must take the stairs because the lift cables are replacing until Friday.
We must take the stairs because the lift cables have been replace until Friday.
We must take the stairs because the lift cables were replaced until Friday.
explanation_ru: Тросы лифта меняют в настоящий период времени (Present Continuous Passive: are being replaced); вариант are replacing означает, что тросы меняют сами себя.

prompt: Nobody knows how the software error ___ during the live video call yesterday evening.
explanation_ru: Глагол happen непереходный (ошибка произошла сама) и не образует пассивный залог: happened.

prompt: After a short talk, I was explained the salary rules by the friendly manager.
answer: After a short talk, the salary rules were explained to me by the friendly manager.
accepted_answers: After a short talk, the salary rules were explained to me by the friendly manager.
After a short talk, the salary rules were explained by the friendly manager.
explanation_ru: В английском пассиве с глаголом explain подлежащим становится то, что объясняют (the salary rules were explained), а не человек.
